text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels satisfying, but I should avoid trimming a position just to lock in gains; consider the stock’s prospects and my overall allocation.","My reluctance to admit a mistake can keep me holding a losing stock too long, so I should reassess it using current evidence rather than my average cost.","With a long horizon and infrequent trading, I should make deliberate decisions and avoid letting short-term price moves drive unnecessary trades."]}
